    • getValueOfItem

      @Nullable protected IValue getValueOfItem(int slotId, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack itemStack)
      Parameters:
      slotId - A slot of the current node.
      itemStack - An item that is not a variable card.
      Returns:
      The constant that the item gives when placed in the slot: the item itself in a slot that takes items, and otherwise the value that the element of the slot's type reads from it, such as the fluid in a bucket. Null if it gives none.

    • getItemOfValue

      public static net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack getItemOfValue(ExpressionNode node)
      Parameters:
      node - A node in a slot.

      The item that a constant is shown as in its slot: the item itself, or the item that the element of its type shows it as, such as a bucket for a fluid. Empty if the node is not a constant that can be shown as an item.

      Parameters:
